name: sabha-standup
description: A standup bot for Sabha: a prompt each morning, replies in its thread, a digest later.

SABHA_BASE_URL.description: Your Sabha's address, such as https://team.sabha.co (with the workspace id after it on Sabha's own hosting).

SABHA_API_KEY.description: The app's key, from Settings → Apps in Sabha. Give the app the post and read_messages permissions.

SABHA_SIGNING_SECRET.description: The app's signing secret, from the same page.

TRANSPORT.description: webhook (the default) or socket. With socket the app holds a live connection and shows online.

STANDUP_ROOM_ID.description: The id of the room the standup runs in; the app must be a member.

STANDUP_TIMEZONE.description: Your team's timezone, such as Europe/London.

STANDUP_DAYS.description: Which days: mon-fri (the default), daily, or a list such as mon,wed,fri.

STANDUP_PROMPT_AT.description: When to ask, in local time, such as 09:30.

STANDUP_DIGEST_AT.description: When to post the digest, such as 16:00.

STANDUP_PROMPT_TEXT.description: What to ask, if not the default.
